verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only imperative automation: a REST API (including graph traversal of bound objects) and an official PowerShell module for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups, plus a scripts repo. That can be scripted and version-controlled, but it is not a declarative provider that keeps identity config reviewable and reproducible. Missing for 10: an official Terraform provider or equivalent declarative tool, documented coverage of apps, groups, and policies as code, plan/drift detection, and independent corroboration.
